lines.text: Step three: start a scan. Three tabs: Ready scan, Template, and Own words.
Ready scan: one tap on Run fills the conditions and runs them. You can change each one afterwards.
Template only fills the conditions; nothing runs until you press Run.
Three templates are always there: Momentum, Oversold, and Trend on the daily. The names are just labels.
Own words, where switched on, turns a plain idea into conditions. Anything it cannot read is listed, never guessed.
See all ready scans opens the library.
Filter by method and setup, then open a card.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
Step four: the conditions. Each one is a block under All of these must pass.
A stock matches only when every switched-on block is true. Each underlined part can be changed: the function, its numbers, the comparison.
To add a block, pick its kind.
Indicator compares a number. Filter is a yes or no check. Category compares a label, such as a trend. Rank keeps the top of your list. Group means either, or.
Then press Add a condition.
A new row appears. Edit it, or switch it off with its tick box.
Information and education only, not investment advice.

scenes.title: Bars ago and the timeframe chip

lines.text: Each side of a row has a timeframe chip, to read that side on another timeframe, such as Daily in a 15 minute scan.
The arrow at the row's end opens advanced options.
Bars ago reads a candle further back, 1 to 500. Blank means the last closed candle.
Here RSI is read three bars ago, and the row says so in plain words.
Structure and pattern functions read the last bar only, with no bars ago or other timeframe.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
